workarounds.symptom: nul.ts filename causes checkout failures when cloning on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(nodejs): rename nul.ts so native Windows clones can check out the tree. Target files: backend/nodejs/apps/src/libs/repositories/activity/pg.ts, backend/nodejs/apps/src/libs/repositories/connectors-config/pg.ts, backend/nodejs/apps/src/libs/repositories/conversation/pg.ts. `git clone https://github.com/pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai.git` fails to complete checkout on native Windows because `backend/nodejs/apps/src/libs/repositories/nul.ts` uses the reserved device name `NUL` (with extension). workarounds.symptom: [BUG] A non-owner editor can turn an agent into a service agent that searches with the owner's access
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): only the owner or an administrator can turn an agent into a service agent. (Ref: https://github.com/pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai/pull/5395)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Empty Claude reply fails the run on the direct Anthropic transport (400)
